events.title: Anatolaks
events.description: Anatolaks is a music band based in Oslo, mainly covering songs in the genres of Turkish-Anatolian and Psychedelic Rock (a fusion of Turkish folk music and rock). The band was founded in 2024 by Arda Unlusoy (drums, back vocal), Burak Kara (vocal, electric guitar), Yavuzer Cetin (electric guitar) and Numan Hekimoglu (bass guitar). Emre Onder Guner (baglama/saz) and Ahmet Emin Memis (darbuka and ney) joined later and completed the band's final lineup. Each member is an experienced musician who has previously performed at various well-known events in Turkiye. These six individuals, each with different backgrounds, came together in Oslo and now share a common goal: to carry the distinctive sound of Anatolia beyond borders!

events.title: Tundra and Lightning 2026 - Friday Pass
events.description: Bergen Live and USF Verftet continue the success following last year's sold-out festival and invite you to the second edition of Tundra and Lightning in Bergen the first weekend of October 2026. The festival will utilize the entire USF and will grow each year in line with the development of the USF Cultural Quarter. We look forward to a beautiful autumn weekend in Bergen with heavy riffs, great atmosphere, and kick ass rock! Friday Pass provide access to the Tundra and Lightning festival at USF Verftet on Friday, October 2. 2026. The festival pass is personal and cannot be shared with others. You will receive an email from the Tundra and Lightning festival with information about exchanging your ticket for a wristband as the festival approaches. Tickets will be available as mobile tickets (QR codes) via the Ticketmaster app and your user account well in advance of the concert (about 14 days). Learn more about delayed delivery of admission passes here. Age limit 18 years, guardian arrangement with a minimum age of 12 years. Fill out the form from tundraandlightning.no before arrival. Festival times will be announced at a later date. HC/Wheelchair users purchase a wheelchair ticket and can bring up to 1 companion. A valid government-issued companion certificate is required for this arrangement. The companion will receive a wristband for that day. Meet at the ticket check for companion registration before entering the festival. For more information about the festival and concerts, see tundraandlightning.no. Follow Tundra and Lightning on Facebook // Instagram // Food and drink will be served at the festival. Food, beverages, bottles, cans, animals, weapons, selfie sticks, and laser pointers are prohibited from being brought into the festival. Alcohol control takes place in licensed areas and through spot checks at the festival. Violation of general licensing rules will result in expulsion and police reporting. The organizer reserves the right to deny entry to persons who refuse personal inspection (This may include body searches and checking any luggage). Persons who are removed do not have the right to have their ticket costs refunded. Changes may occur, Tundra and Lightning is a festival and refunds are only given in the event of total cancellation of either the entire festival or a single day of the festival.

events.title: MACY GRAY - THE TROUBLE WITH THE TRUTH TOUR
events.description: On November 15, 2026, one of modern soul's most distinctive voices takes the stage at Røkeriet. With her raspy, unmistakable vocals, funky energy, and uncompromising approach to soul, Macy Gray has been in a league of her own ever since her breakthrough in the late '90s. Her music is direct, honest, and full of personality -- with songs that hit just as hard on the dance floor as they do in the heart. Gray achieved her international breakthrough in 1999 with her triple-platinum debut album On How Life Is. The album featured the global hit "I Try," which earned her a Grammy Award for Best Female Pop Vocal Performance. Since then, she has sold more than 25 million albums, received five Grammy nominations and two BRIT Awards, and built a devoted fan base around the world. Throughout her career, she has collaborated with artists including Ariana Grande, Bobby Brown, and Galactic, while cementing her reputation as a formidable live performer. On stage, she blends soul, R&B, and funk with raw presence, humor, and a voice you recognize from the very first note. In addition to her music career, Macy Gray has also made her mark as an actress, appearing in films and TV series including Training Day, For Colored Girls, and Fuller House. Show time: 8:00 PM Doors open: 60 minutes before showtime Duration: 75 minutes Food & beverage: Fully licensed bar Age restriction: 18+ Companion: Free admission for companions with a valid companion ticket Wheelchair accessible: Yes Parking: Yes Links: YouTube Spotify Instagram Facebook

events.title: Bergen Calling: KARPE (DIEM) - OVERTIME/OVERKILL (2000-2028)
events.description: Bergen Calling - one-day festival at Bergenhus Fortress on Saturday, August 7, 2027. PLEASE NOTE! Standing only - including Front Floor. Front Floor is a limited-capacity ticket category that provides access to an area in front of the stage, with its own entrance, bars and toilets. There is a maximum ticket limit of 8 tickets per person. Age restriction: 18+ with a guardian scheme. The minimum age when accompanied by a guardian is 15. Guests under the age of 18 must be accompanied by a sober adult aged 23 or over. The guardian form is available on Bergen Live's website and must be completed before arriving at the concert venue. Tickets for the accessible area (including a companion, if applicable) are available via this accessible ticket link. Wheelchair users are directed to a dedicated area or platform that provides a good view of the stage and a safe concert experience. Capacity is limited. Priority is given to wheelchair users, followed by guests with other mobility impairments. If the platform reaches capacity, companions will be required to stand in the surrounding area. Read more about this here. Food and beverages are available for purchase inside the concert area. Read more practical concert information from the promoter, Bergen Live, here. When purchasing beer or wine, ID checks will be carried out at the entrances to the bar areas, as well as through random checks within the concert area. Violations of alcohol regulations (guests under the age of 18 consuming alcohol and guests purchasing alcohol for anyone under the age of 18) will result in removal from the concert area and will be reported to the police on site. Earplugs are available free of charge at selected outlets within the concert area. Food, beverages, bottles, cans, umbrellas, folding chairs, animals, weapons and laser pointers are prohibited inside the concert area. Please note that guests will not be permitted to re-enter the concert area if they leave, unless there is a particularly valid reason and this has been agreed with a member of the promoter's staff at the entrance. For more information about the concert, please visit Bergen Live's (promoter) website or Facebook page.
